resume: Contenu original – licence CC BY-SA 4.0. Débattre de l'école et de ses méthodes, puis parler de l'avenir de la presse et de l'information à l'ère numérique.
notions: Éducation et médias : mise en situation
Éducation et médias : adjectifs et adverbes
Éducation et médias : expressions et mots de liaison

sections.contenu: *Should schools ban smartphones? Supporters argue that phones **distract** pupils and encourage **cyberbullying**. Opponents claim that, used properly, they help students **develop** digital skills. Meanwhile, the media landscape is changing: **print newspapers** are losing **readers**, while news **podcasts** and online **subscriptions** are growing. The main challenge is **fake news**: readers must learn to **check** their **sources**.*
notions: Éducation et médias : mise en situation

|---|---|---|
| **to teach / to learn** | enseigner / apprendre | *She teaches maths; I learn coding.* |
| **to graduate** | obtenir son diplôme | *He graduated from university in 2024.* |
| **to fail / to pass (an exam)** | échouer à / réussir (un examen) | *I passed my driving test!* |
| **to broadcast** | diffuser (radio, télé) | *The debate was broadcast live.* |
| **to subscribe (to)** | s'abonner (à) | *I subscribe to two newspapers.* |
| **to check / to fact-check** | vérifier | *Journalists must fact-check every claim.* |
| **to distract** | distraire, détourner l'attention | *Notifications distract students.* |

| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **a pupil / a student** | un élève / un étudiant | *The class has twenty-five pupils.* |
| **a degree** | un diplôme (universitaire) | *She has a degree in computer science.* |
| **tuition fees** | frais de scolarité | *Tuition fees are high in some countries.* |
| **a headline** | un gros titre | *The headline was misleading.* |
| **fake news** | fausses informations | *Fake news spreads quickly online.* |
| **a source** | une source | *Always quote your sources.* |
| **the press** | la presse | *Freedom of the press is essential.* |

| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **biased** | partial, orienté | *This article is clearly biased.* |
| **reliable** | fiable | *Is this website a reliable source?* |
| **misleading** | trompeur | *The graph is misleading.* |
| **compulsory** | obligatoire | *School is compulsory until 16.* |
| **up-to-date** | à jour | *The app gives up-to-date news.* |
| **online / in print** | en ligne / sur papier | *I read the paper online.* |

sections.contenu:

|---|---|---|
| **Supporters argue that…** | les partisans soutiennent que… | *Supporters argue that uniforms reduce inequality.* |
| **Opponents claim that…** | les opposants affirment que… | *Opponents claim it limits freedom.* |
